identity.kind: office chair (task chair / swivel office chair)

claims.claim: Bent office chair available for sale.
claims.evidence: The photo shows a used chair, but I cannot clearly confirm a specific 'bent' part (e.g., base/legs/arm) from this single angle.
No location details are visible in the photo.

risks.risk: The chair may actually be bent (base/legs/armrest) causing wobble or unsafe use; this photo doesn’t clearly prove the bend.
risks.proof: A short video showing the chair on a flat floor while you gently rock it side-to-side and front-to-back, plus a close-up of the base/underframe and armrest from both sides.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: bent/unstable chair (reduced value for possible repair or limited usability).

risks.risk: Seat/back fabric condition may be worse than it looks (tears, deep stains, bad foam).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the seat and backrest fabric (front, underside if possible) and a photo of any tears/holes.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: worn fabric with possible stains (no guarantee of comfort).

risks.risk: Gas lift and swivel may be faulty (won’t raise/lower smoothly, sticks, or doesn’t swivel properly).
risks.proof: Video demonstrating height adjustment up/down and full swivel left/right, showing it holds position.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: height adjustment/swivel not guaranteed (assume basic function only).

risks.risk: Caster wheels may be damaged or not rolling well.
risks.proof: Close-up of all 5 casters and a clip rolling the chair forward/backward across the floor.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: casters may need replacement.

proof_requests: Video rocking test on a flat floor (front/back and left/right) to confirm whether anything is bent and whether it wobbles.
Close-up photos of the base/underframe and both armrests for any bends or cracks.
Video showing height adjustment (up/down) and that it holds height.
Video showing swivel and caster rolling (forward/back and turning).
Close-up photos of seat/back fabric for tears/holes and foam condition.
response.reason: The chair type is clear, but the key seller claim ('bent') is not verifiable from the single photo angle; decisive proof (wobble/underframe close-ups) is needed before pricing confidently.
